race.title: Docker Hughes Memorial Race Handicap Chase
race.verdict: UNCLE AL jumped better than usual when routing Daring Plan at Fontwell last time and looks capable of confirming that superiority despite meeting that rival on 5 lb worse terms, even if Susan Gardner’s charge should get closer. Back It Up is hard to weigh up but could improve for the fitting of a visor. UNCLE AL (IRE) DARING PLAN (IRE) BACK IT UP (IRE)
